license: original-work: authored for LEDGER in this repository, no external source
register: D3: dry British wit, seaside-postcard smut sparingly, noir holds (canon, Tone); spoken lines, British 1990
status: PROPOSED, not in the game: a proposed addition for the PC session to adopt after its tests (NOTES.md says how). Unreviewed by a fresh reader; dialogue, so on Jafar's page before it merges.

fields.bank: the existing street-lines bank key (StreetVoice.cs 'ambient/open/night', 'recognition/avoids'): the ledger keeps 'bank@kind' exactly as it keeps 'bank@id' for OwnLines
fields.context: the family of moment (greeting, bump, rain, crime, deed, way, farewell), as the dialogue bank's own context
fields.situation: the moment itself; kind is who says it; speaker repeats kind because the dialogue bank's own field is called speaker (check_lines.py requires them equal)
fields.rung: the standing rung a greeting reads out (stranger, owner, nowak, tom, tommy), else any: the dialogue bank's own field
fields.idRung: crime lines only: how sure the speaker is, on the dialogue bank's identification ladder: 0 a noise heard, 1 a shape, 3 a face (2 and 4 have no ambient lines: see NOTES.md)
fields.conditions: every key present must hold: standing (rungs), weather (dry, drizzle, rain), time (morning, afternoon, evening, night), sure (noise, shape, face), destination (a place id), since_deed_s ([from, to]), rain_began_within_s
fields.weight: 1 to 3: the chance of being drawn next among the lines not yet used in the group's bag; every line is still used once per bag
fields.group: the cooldown group and the shuffle bag: one per kind and bank, the ledger's own key
fields.delivery: normal, hushed (witnesses quieter for an hour: RULINGS 23 Sep) or raised
fields.dialect: local if the line uses a northern dialect word: never given to a speaker whose voice is not the local one
fields.calls_police: present and true if the line rings, tells or fetches the police: never given to the people who never go to them (rules.json speaker_overrides.never_police)

weather.dry: Weather.Rain below 0.10 (dry overcast; the street may still be wet)

shopkeeper.what: somebody behind a counter or in a doorway: the fish shop, the pawn, the coin shop, the caff, the takeaway, the boarding house

dock_worker.what: dockside and quayside hands: the crane, the yard, the fish dock, the scrap, the ferry

pensioner.what: the old of the street: retired, on the pension, the chapel's women, the net-mender

office_worker.what: desks and counters of paper: the books, the radio and phone, the harbour office, customs, the paper, the ferry's ticket desk, the rent collector's round

driver.what: wheels for hire or for the firm: the cab on Mickey's rank, the bus, the lorry

laundry_worker.what: the steam laundry's floor and the seamstress's bench: presses, folding, pins and thread

tradesman.what: somebody who mends, makes or paints for a living: locks, engines, signs, wiring, welding, print

night_shift.what: those who work while the street sleeps: the watchman, the janitor, the guard, the nurse coming off a shift

casual_worker.what: no steady work in 1990: casual days on the quay, laid off, looking for anything

ron.what: Ron Kirby's own lines: the door and the rank, 58, low and worn, 'boss' and 'friend'

darren.what: Darren Milner's own lines: 25, the street hustler, quick, useful, always talking

father_walsh.what: Father Walsh's own lines: about 61, the Irish-born parish priest, soft and slow, 'the guards'

june.what: June Suddaby's own lines: 38, Mickey's daughter, back for the funeral and leaving soon, clipped and on guard

anyone.what: any resident who knows the place: the shared directions, one set of words per place (a place's facts are the place's, not a kind's)

no_kind.tom: the player: his words are typed
no_kind.ellis: DS Ellis speaks in authored scenes and live talk (game-design/ellis-2026-09-29.md), not from street banks
no_kind.aldous: a head of a rival organisation: authored and live talk only, never a passer-by's greeting
no_kind.sera: a head of a rival organisation: authored and live talk only
no_kind.danny: a head of a rival organisation: authored and live talk only
no_kind.fixer: the Fixer brokers between the three: authored and live talk only
no_kind.outfit_man: the outfit's man is never named and never speaks to a stranger (canon; town list 6z)
